fields.subject: SqlServerProvider.DataProviderServiceFactory
fields.trigger: a provider-neutral caller prepares a query contract with a destination command, source SQL parameters, requested parameter names, and optional replacement values
fields.response: copy every source SQL parameter when requested parameter names are absent or empty; otherwise copy only source parameters whose names match the normalized requested names, preserving their provider metadata and original value except where a replacement value exists for the parameter name
fields.postcondition: the destination command contains the selected SQL parameters in the requested-selection order
